about_the_game:
The Warlocks Maze demo will give you a good taste of what's to come in the full game.

  • Hunt a Dragon!

  • Two Floors to explore

  • One Playable Faction

  • Over 50 Units as well as Items and Abilities

  • Several fully implemented systems like;

    •  Merchants and Taverns to buy gear and hire adventures.

    • Events and unit Proficiencies

    •  Combat Tactics

However note that some main features like Multiplayer and meta progression in the form of building your base camp between runs are not included in the demo.
